title: CandidateMatchResponse
description: Contract B: Ranked candidate match output from Backend/Scorer consumed by Pavanesh's Recruiter UI

linkedin_url.description: Candidate's validated or extracted LinkedIn profile URL

total_experience_years.description: Extracted total years of professional experience

confidence_score.description: Deterministic confidence score (0-100) computed purely via application math

mandatory_matched.description: List of mandatory skills found in the candidate profile

mandatory_missing.description: List of mandatory skills requested by JD but missing on candidate profile

optional_matched.description: List of optional / nice-to-have skills matched

evidence_snippets.description: Verbatim resume text snippets providing evidence for claimed skills

fit_summary.description: Concise 1-2 sentence LLM summary of technical fit and gaps
